Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's inherited effect to delete another of my level 3 Digimon cards with the [Beast] trait and then play that deleted Digimon card from the trash without paying the cost?

a: If a card is removed from the trash before a triggered [On Deletion] effect activates, that [On Deletion] effect can't be activated.
Card Q&A.q: I used this card's inherited effect to delete a level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] effect and the [Beast] trait, then I played that deleted Digimon card from the trash without paying the cost. Can I activate the deleted Digimon's [On Deletion] effect at such times?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 3 green or yellow Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your other suspended Digimon, you may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with the [Beast] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
